name: london-dispatch
description: 런던_디스패치 — 흑집사 자캐 갠홈용 iframe AI 캐릭터 대화창 (Cloudflare Workers + Hono + D1 / Vite + React)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,ui -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.build: npm run build -w ui && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p ui
